parameters.query:
INSERT INTO messages (
  platform,
  page_id,
  customer_platform_id,
  platform_message_id,
  message_type,
  text,
  attachments,
  raw_event,
  created_at,
  processed
)
VALUES (
  $1, $2, $3, $4, $5, $6,
  $7::jsonb,
  $8::jsonb,
  $9::timestamptz,
  FALSE
)
ON CONFLICT (platform_message_id)
DO NOTHING
RETURNING id, platform_message_id, customer_platform_id;

WITH pending AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT
    platform,
    page_id,
    customer_platform_id
  FROM messages
  WHERE processed = FALSE
)
SELECT
  p.platform,
  p.page_id,
  p.customer_platform_id,
  COALESCE(
    (
      SELECT json_agg(x ORDER BY x.created_at)
      FROM (
        SELECT
          m2.text,
          m2.message_type,
          m2.created_at
        FROM messages m2
        WHERE m2.platform = p.platform
          AND m2.page_id = p.page_id
          AND m2.customer_platform_id = p.customer_platform_id
        ORDER BY m2.created_at DESC
        LIMIT 50
      ) x
    ),
    '[]'::json
  ) AS messages,
  (
    SELECT COUNT(*)
    FROM messages m3
    WHERE m3.platform = p.platform
      AND m3.page_id = p.page_id
      AND m3.customer_platform_id = p.customer_platform_id
      AND m3.processed = FALSE
  ) AS pending_count,
  COALESCE(to_jsonb(cs), '{}'::jsonb) AS old_state
FROM pending p
LEFT JOIN customer_state cs
  ON cs.platform = p.platform
 AND cs.page_id = p.page_id
 AND cs.customer_platform_id = p.customer_platform_id;

INSERT INTO customer_state (
  platform,
  page_id,
  customer_platform_id,
  phone,
  email,
  customer_name,
  intents,
  product,
  brand,
  product_code,
  quantity,
  budget_min,
  budget_max,
  use_case,
  requirements,
  purchase_time,
  request_quote,
  request_callback,
  urgency,
  summary,
  confidence,
  lead_score,
  lead_status,
  updated_at
)
VALUES (
  $1, $2, $3, $4, $5, $6,
  $7::jsonb,
  $8, $9, $10, $11, $12, $13, $14,
  $15::jsonb,
  $16, $17, $18, $19, $20, $21, $22, $23,
  NOW()
)
ON CONFLICT (platform, page_id, customer_platform_id)
DO UPDATE SET
  phone = COALESCE(EXCLUDED.phone, customer_state.phone),
  email = COALESCE(EXCLUDED.email, customer_state.email),
  customer_name = COALESCE(EXCLUDED.customer_name, customer_state.customer_name),
  intents = CASE
    WHEN jsonb_array_length(EXCLUDED.intents) > 0 THEN EXCLUDED.intents
    ELSE customer_state.intents
  END,
  product = COALESCE(EXCLUDED.product, customer_state.product),
  brand = COALESCE(EXCLUDED.brand, customer_state.brand),
  product_code = COALESCE(EXCLUDED.product_code, customer_state.product_code),
  quantity = COALESCE(EXCLUDED.quantity, customer_state.quantity),
  budget_min = COALESCE(EXCLUDED.budget_min, customer_state.budget_min),
  budget_max = COALESCE(EXCLUDED.budget_max, customer_state.budget_max),
  use_case = COALESCE(EXCLUDED.use_case, customer_state.use_case),
  requirements = CASE
    WHEN jsonb_array_length(EXCLUDED.requirements) > 0 THEN EXCLUDED.requirements
    ELSE customer_state.requirements
  END,
  purchase_time = COALESCE(EXCLUDED.purchase_time, customer_state.purchase_time),
  request_quote = EXCLUDED.request_quote OR customer_state.request_quote,
  request_callback = EXCLUDED.request_callback OR customer_state.request_callback,
  urgency = EXCLUDED.urgency,
  summary = EXCLUDED.summary,
  confidence = EXCLUDED.confidence,
  lead_score = EXCLUDED.lead_score,
  lead_status = EXCLUDED.lead_status,
  updated_at = NOW()
RETURNING
  platform,
  page_id,
  customer_platform_id,
  lead_score,
  lead_status;

UPDATE messages
SET processed = TRUE,
    processed_at = NOW()
WHERE platform = $1
  AND page_id = $2
  AND customer_platform_id = $3
  AND processed = FALSE
RETURNING id;
